thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 - GPU pool 'eu-west-1-gpu' experiencing sustained queue growth and autoscaler errors. queue_length=4820, avg_latency=2.9s, scale_attempts=14, failures=14. Investigate.

oncall-matt: I'm on it, grabbing logs + triage. Paging SRE.

sre-ana: Looking - autoscaler logs show repeated 'scale_limit_reached' and 'quotaExceeded' from cloud provider. Seems like scale api returning 429/409.

infra-lin: Confirmed from infra side. Provider quota for vGPU cores hit for this account/region. Autoscaler is stuck retrying but backoff isn't increasing capacity due to hard quota.

oncall-matt: Customer impact? any 5xxs?

eng-runtime: Metrics: internal request throttles increased, we started dropping requests once queue > 4000. Per-route latencies spiking. Suggest temporary fallback to smaller model variant (gen-small-2) to free up GPU memory and reduce per-token compute. Also enable aggressive prefix caching for common prompts.

sre-ana: Poking metrics:
```
# current queue distribution (top routes)
/complete/text: 2120
/chat/generate: 1430
/embeddings: 610
/streaming: 660
# autoscaler status
last_scale_attempt: 2026-03-15T12:08:02Z
scale_attempts: 14
last_error: quotaExceeded (account vGPU cores)
```

customer-success-julia: Hearing from a few mid-market customers about timeouts. One support ticket flagged 504s for their batch jobs. We should notify impacted customers quickly.

oncall-matt: Agreed. I'll send a short incident message to affected customers after we stabilize. For now, let's try model fallback + per-customer throttles. Can infra open emergency quota with provider? how long to get extra cores?

infra-lin: I've opened support case but quota increase is manual; typical ETA 10-30m if expedited. Meanwhile we can reassign some reserved Dedicated capacity from non-critical pools, but that needs ops approval.

eng-runtime: I'll push a routing change to route lower-tier/anonymous traffic to gen-small-2 and reduce per-request max_tokens to 512 for 15m window. This will free up ~30-40% GPU time.

oncall-matt: Go for it. Post commands you run.

eng-runtime: Running rollout:
```bash
# routing override to fallback model for anonymous requests
redwoodctl routing set --match "auth==null" --model gen-small-2 --max_tokens 512 --duration 15m
```

deploy-bot: rollout started by eng-runtime. Rollout id: r-20260315-001. Canarying to 20% of traffic for 60s then 100%.

sre-ana: Also toggled plan-b: temporary rate-limit for batch endpoints to 5 reqs/min per customer to stop spike from long-running jobs.

oncall-matt: I posted a brief CS message: "We're experiencing increased latency and timeouts in EU region due to autoscaler quota. We're applying temporary fallbacks and rate limits; we'll update in 15m." :mailbox_with_mail:

customer-success-julia: Thanks. I'll triage inbound tickets and escalate if any major accounts call.

infra-lin: Support case updated - provider says they can approve +200 vGPU cores in ~18 minutes if we accept limiter on placement. They requested confirmation.

product-oliver: If it buys us time, approve it. We need to weigh cost vs customer impact.

oncall-matt: Approving emergency +200 cores. infra-lin, please proceed.

infra-lin: Confirmed, provider accepted. Spinning up reserved nodes, ETA ~16m.

sre-ana: Rollout completed to 100% for fallback; initial telemetry shows queue shrinking: current queue_length=2700, avg_latency=2.1s. Still high but trending down.

eng-runtime: Also enabled prefix caching on top 10 routes, estimated tokens saved ~18%.

oncall-matt: Good. Any lingering 5xxs?

sre-ana: 5xx rate dropped from 3.2% to 0.9% over last 6 minutes. Timeouts (504) still at 1.1% due to in-flight long running jobs.

customer-success-julia: Notified top 5 impacted customers with ETA and mitigation steps. Keeping them updated.

deploy-bot: New nodes reported healthy and joined pool at 2026-03-15T12:26:12Z.

infra-lin: New capacity live. Autoscaler recovered and scaled up to absorb backlog. Current queue_length=420, avg_latency=0.9s.

eng-runtime: Reverting anonymous routing back to default model in 2m to validate stability.

eng-runtime: Revert command:
```bash
redwoodctl routing unset --match "auth==null" --rollout r-20260315-001 --duration 2m
```

sre-ana: Monitoring - system stable, no new scale errors.

oncall-matt: OK, handing over to SRE for follow-up postmortem and action items. @sre-ana you're owner for post-incident doc + immediate followups. I'll take blameless review next week.

sre-ana: Taking owner. Summary for handoff:
- root cause: cloud provider vGPU core quota exhausted in eu-west-1 during sudden demand spike. Autoscaler retried but couldn't increase due to hard quota -> queue growth.
- mitigations: (1) temporary model fallback to gen-small-2, (2) per-customer batch throttles, (3) emergency quota request and reserved nodes reassign, (4) prefix caching.
- impact: increased latency and 504s for ~7% of requests in EU region; several mid-market customers saw batch job failures; no data loss.

sre-ana: Immediate action items I'll own:
1. Postmortem doc (owner: sre-ana) - due EOD tomorrow.
2. Short-term: add automatic detection rule to trigger provider quota escalation workflow when autoscaler errors show 'quotaExceeded' (owner: infra-lin) - due 72h.
3. Medium-term: implement capacity circuit-breaker to surface quota limits earlier and route to fallback models automatically (owner: eng-runtime) - due 2 weeks.
4. Add per-customer backpressure controls & dashboard (owner: eng-platform) - due 1 week.
5. Run runbook review and tabletop for autoscaler quota scenarios (owner: oncall-matt) - schedule by next sprint.

product-oliver: Also recommend we revisit default model assignment for anonymous traffic; fallback policy should be explicit under heavy load. Adding to product backlog.

customer-success-julia: I'll compile impacted customer list + support threads for postmortem.

oncall-matt: Thanks all. Hand-off complete. Leaving a short note for execs and ops: "Incident EU GPU capacity exhausted; mitigations applied; capacity restored; postmortem in progress." :white_check_mark:

sre-ana: Closing thread for live triage. Will update with postmortem link when ready. Action items and owners recorded.

incident-bot: Incident status set to "mitigated" by oncall-matt at 2026-03-15T12:34:35Z.

sre-ana: Postmortem rough notes: will include timeline, triggering demand vector, autoscaler behavior, provider quota process, and specific remediation patches. Expect doc link in this thread within 24h.

oncall-matt: Great work everyone. :teamwork_tone1:
